series: Natural History Gallery · The Coffee Garden
title: The Coffee Bee
subject: bee

details.name: The Flower It Seeks
details.note: White, jasmine-scented, open two days only. In Ethiopia's highlands it has no native honeybee — yet the flower still pays in nectar.

details.name: The Crossing
details.note: Wings carry pollen from one blossom to the next; a tree crossed this way sets fuller fruit than one left to the wind.

details.name: The Long Carry
details.note: What the basket holds here becomes a drink carried from Kaffa to Mocha, to Java, to every city on earth.
